title: digit.boundUuids: one value of the multi-valued search index
description: Multi-valued Keycloak user attribute: one '<tenantId>|<uuid>' value per pending or active binding in digit.bindings, written in the same PUT. Keycloak cannot search inside JSON, so ownership is checked with GET /users?q=digit.boundUuids:<tenantId>|<uuid>&exact=true. A removed binding drops its value, which releases the DIGIT account.
